"''The kid.|Cara Dune and the Mandalorian discuss the bounty hunter's intentions|}} A [[Kubaz]] [[Gender|male]] operated as a '''bounty hunter''' during the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]]. The Kubaz tracked a target, a [[Din Grogu|child]] under the protection of the bounty hunter known as [[Din Djarin|the Mandalorian]], to the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]]. The Kubaz intended to [[Death|kill]] the target, but was shot and killed by [[Carasynthia Dune]]. ==Biography== The [[Kubaz]] [[bounty hunter]] was a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] during the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Era|Era]]. In [[9 ABY]], he received a [[tracking fob]] to hunt down a [[Din Grogu|child]]. The Kubaz tracked the child to the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]] where he had been taken by another [[bounty]] [[hunter]] named [[Din Djarin]], known as "the Mandalorian." Following the fob's trail through a forest, he found the [[Mandalorian]] and the child at a [[Unidentified village (Sorgan)|village]]. The Kubaz aimed at the Mandalorian while he talked to a [[Omera|resident]] before switching his aim to the child. However, the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] sneaked behind him and shot the bounty hunter in the back before he could [[Death|kill]] the child. The Mandalorian arrived at the scene, after hearing the shot, and rolled the Kubaz's body over, finding and destroying the tracking fob. Knowing that the Guild was after the child, the Mandalorian departed Sorgan. ==Equipment== The Kubaz bounty hunter wore a [[Color|black]] fur coat with a round metal hood. He also had a silver metal mask covering his face and snout. The bounty hunter used a [[sniper rifle]] with a crosshair that allowed him to magnify his targets. ==Behind the scenes== The Kubaz bounty hunter appeared in "[[Chapter 4: Sanctuary]]," the fourth episode of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[November 29]], 2019.{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}} ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian'' Junior Novel]] {{Ab|The Mandalorian Junior Novel (audiobook)}} {{Corpse}} *''[[The Mandalorian: Season 1: Volume 1]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian: The Manga]]'' *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 4: Sanctuary}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian 4|''The Mandalorian'' 4]] *[[The Mandalorian 5|''The Mandalorian'' 5]] {{C|Indirectly mentioned only; in the opening crawl}} ==Sources== *{{DisneyGallery|Directing}} *{{DisneyGallery|Cast}} *{{SW|url=series/the-mandalorian/chapter-4-guide|text="Sanctuary" Episode Guide | The Mandalorian}} {{Imo}} *[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian: Guide to Season One|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'': Guide to Season One]] *{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Cazarrecompensas kubaz no identificado |fr=Chasseur de primes Kubaz non-identifié |ja=名称不明のクバーズの賞金稼ぎ |ka=უცნობი კუბაზი ჯილდოზე მონადირე |pl=Łowca nagród (Sorgan) }} [[Category:Bounty Hunters' Guild bounty hunters]] [[Category:Kubaz]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Sharpshooters and snipers]]
